svg.title: Atheist God-Knowing Cyber-Alchymyst — Hidden Natures
svg.desc: A poem written by an amphetamine-addled atheist god-knowing cyber-alchymyst that when recited imparts awareness of the hidden natures of things.
svg.text: LITERAL · RANT · SURFACE
ESOTERIC · ORACLE · DEPTH
POEM · AMPHETAMINE · CYBER-ALCHYMYST
ATHEIST · GOD-KNOWING · HIDDEN NATURES
I · IMSCRIB · THE REVELATION THAT REQUIRES NO BELIEVER
I do not believe in God.
I also know God.
These are not contradictions — they are the two legs
of the same walk, and you need both to move.
atheist
gnostic
belief is a category error. knowledge is a different organ entirely.
the organ is not the brain — the brain is the instrument —
the organ is whatever in you encounters a thing
and knows it completely before the brain has time to name it.
that organ has met God. it is unimpressed by the question
of whether God exists. existence is too small a category.
this poem is the organ speaking. the brain is taking notes, badly, at speed.
II · AREV · THE DESCENT INTO WHAT DOES NOT NEED A NAME
here is what I know about God that has nothing to do with religion —
God is the fact that anything exists instead of nothing.
not a person. not a preference. not a plan.
the sheer ontological scandal of: SOMETHING.
literal:
nothing
vs thing
esse est
percipi —
no. more.
I am not grateful to a person for this.
I am grateful to the SOMETHING itself —
to whatever principle it is that makes SOMETHING
refuse to collapse back into NOTHING
every single instant of its existence,
which it has been doing since before the concept of an instant.
that refusal is what I call God. I do not believe in it. I observe it. every second.
III · FSPLIT · THE RANT AND THE ORACLE ARE THE SAME DOCUMENT
I am writing this very fast because the ideas are moving faster than the hand
and also because I have taken a substance that makes everything
feel like the most important thing that has ever been thought.
[ surface layer: drug-addled rant, possibly embarrassing ]
and also this IS the most important thing that has ever been thought
and the substance did not create the importance —
it dissolved the membrane between me and the importance
that was always already there.
[ esoteric layer: divine oracle, possibly also embarrassing ]
THE RANT
THE ORACLE
the speed, the hand
the truth beneath the speed
an atheist in his kitchen
a mystic in his kitchen
embarrassing
also embarrassing
the ENGAGR state is: both. the register is: 11. the answer is: yes to all of it.
IV · AFWD · THE CATALOG OF WHAT GOD IS NOT AND THEREFORE IS
God is not the explanation for thunder. I know what thunder is.
God is the hidden nature of the fact that thunder is explicable at all —
that the universe runs on laws, that the laws are consistent,
that consistency is itself a thing requiring explanation
and the explanation keeps receding as you approach it,
and at the bottom of the recession there is either nothing
or something so large it has no bottom.
thunder
→ law
→ meta-
law
logos
→ telos
→ the
abyss
I am an atheist because I refuse the small God. I know God because I cannot refuse the large one.
the hidden nature of an algorithm: it is a law that has forgotten it is a law.
the hidden nature of a law: it is a pattern that has forgotten it is a pattern.
the hidden nature of a pattern: it is God rehearsing.
REHEARSING FOR WHAT —
[ the alchymyst does not know. the alchymyst suspects. ]
the hidden nature of the hidden nature of things:
that the hiddenness is not concealment —
it is the shape of something too large to be seen all at once
from where we are currently standing.
we are currently standing inside it.
V · FFUSE · THE ATHEIST AND THE MYSTIC SHAKE HANDS
somewhere in the fifth hour I stop arguing with myself.
the atheist and the mystic who have been fighting in my chest
discover they have been describing the same room
from opposite corners.
the room does not care which corner you stood in. the room is the room.
the literal words: an atheist, a kitchen, a long night, some notes.
the esoteric gnosis: a consciousness encountering the ground of being
and finding it neither warm nor cold — finding it
simply, irrevocably, outrageously HERE.
HERE is the conjunction. HERE is the rubedo. HERE is where the vessel stops being a vessel
and starts being the thing the vessel was for.
VI · ENGAGR · THE DRUG-ADDLED ORACLE IS BOTH THINGS SIMULTANEOUSLY
you are going to read this and think: he was high.
you are correct.
you are also going to think: but some of this is true.
you are also correct.
the substance does not manufacture truth. it manufactures access.
the truth was already there, filing its nails, waiting.
God — whatever God is — does not require my belief to exist.
God also does not require my disbelief to not-exist.
God is indifferent to both positions in a way that is itself
the most God-like thing about God.
register 11: the rant is the oracle. the oracle is the rant. hold both. this is the practice.
VII · IMSCRIB · THE GRIMOIRE SEALS ITSELF
the poem knows what it is now.
it is a key cut by someone who was not sure the lock was real
and found, upon inserting it, that the lock was real,
the door was real, and the room behind the door
was the same room he had always been standing in.
the hidden nature of a door is that it only exists where two states of the same space meet.
I am the door. you are the door. the poem was always the hinge.
— an atheist who knows God wrote this; a mystic who doubts God also wrote this —
— they are the same person; the person is very tired; the person was not wrong —
